title: Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade Schedule: Qualification and Line Sizing
content:
Every Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line is graded on one of six Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grades, from Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 to Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1. A grade is assigned to the dealership whose Kestrel dealer risk score meets the grade's minimum score together with the grade's minimum tangible net worth, and the grade then sets the size of the dealership's new-vehicle line and used-vehicle line.

## Schedule of grade thresholds and line multiples

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Minimum Kestrel dealer risk score (1-100) | Minimum dealership tangible net worth (USD) | New-vehicle line, in months of average monthly new unit sales value | Used-vehicle line, percent of the new line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 40 | 500000 | 1.5 | 15 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 50 | 750000 | 2.0 | 20 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 60 | 1000000 | 2.5 | 25 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 70 | 1500000 | 3.0 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 80 | 2500000 | 3.0 | 35 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 90 | 4000000 | 3.5 | 40 |

## Terms as defined for this schedule

- **Minimum Kestrel dealer risk score**: the lowest Kestrel dealer risk score (1-100) for the grade.
- **Minimum tangible net worth**: the minimum dealership tangible net worth, in USD.
- **New-vehicle line multiple**: the new-vehicle line as a multiple of average monthly new unit sales value, expressed in months.
- **Used-vehicle line percent**: the used-vehicle line as a percent of the new line.

A grade's two entry thresholds are read together: a dealership meets a grade's entry gate only when its risk score is at least that grade's minimum score and its tangible net worth is at least that grade's minimum tangible net worth.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical dealerships)

The figures below are illustrative inputs chosen for this schedule only; they describe no actual dealership.

| Hypothetical dealership | Risk score | Tangible net worth (USD) | Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 entry gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 70 | 1500000 | Met: both figures sit exactly on the minimums |
| B | 69 | 1600000 | Not met: the score is one point below 70 |
| C | 75 | 1499999 | Not met: net worth is below 1500000 |

Line sizing on the same schedule, again on hypothetical figures: a dealership graded Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 whose average monthly new unit sales value is 800000 USD has a new-vehicle line of 2.5 months of that value, which is 2000000 USD, and a used-vehicle line of 25 percent of that new line, which is 500000 USD.
